description: Answers "will it rain?" for the next 1-12 hours at any point: whether rain (or snow, as liquid water) is forecast, the first wet hour, the total, and the amount hour by hour. Useful before a walk, run, school run or outdoor job. Source: MET Norway Locationforecast 2.0 hourly precipitation (model forecast, not radar nowcast), times in UTC. Needs lat and lon: for a UK place name or postcode, get coordinates from geocode or postcode_lookup first. (cost: 1 credit)

hours.description: integer, optional, how many hours ahead from the current hour (1-12), default 6

lat.description: number, required, latitude in decimal degrees (-90 to 90)

lon.description: number, required, longitude in decimal degrees (-180 to 180)

name: rain_forecast_next_hours
